competitors.name: Walmart / Papa Johns
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Walmart will add Papa Johns ordering to walmart.com and its app under the restaurants tab, with 30-minute-or-less delivery launching at select locations in the coming weeks and expanding to thousands of U.S. locations. Orders can be placed separately or added to an online grocery cart as part of Walmart Express Delivery, with Spark contractors handling delivery.

competitors.name: Fresh Thyme Market
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Fresh Thyme's inaugural Pitch Thyme competition will put four Michigan local brands on shelves in late September: Bingo Roasters, Mimidae Beverage Company, Red Truck Orchards and Gnarly Sauce Co. The natural grocer plans in-store sampling and intends to expand the Pitch Thyme model to other Midwest markets.

competitors.name: Kroger
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Kroger's Q2 adjusted e-commerce sales rose 20% and retail media grew 24%, while private-label sales grew more than 14%. Kroger said Our Brand sales outpaced national brands, penetration rose about 50 basis points, and recent private-label growth was driven by new products including expanded ready-to-heat and ready-to-eat meals.

trends.topic: Restaurant delivery moving inside grocery carts
trends.magnitude: Walmart plans Papa Johns delivery through its app and website at thousands of U.S. locations after a fall pilot.
trends.context: Mass retailers are positioning hot restaurant pizza as an add-on to grocery delivery, increasing competition for quick dinner occasions that overlap with frozen pizza.

trends.topic: Midwest natural grocers sourcing local emerging brands
trends.magnitude: Fresh Thyme will add four Michigan local brands from Pitch Thyme and plans to expand the event to other Midwest markets.
trends.context: Regional natural retailers are formalizing local-vendor pipelines and sampling support, creating potential entry paths but also higher competition for artisan and specialty food brands.

trends.topic: Private-label ready meals gaining retailer investment
trends.magnitude: Kroger private-label sales grew more than 14% in Q2, with penetration up about 50 basis points and expanded ready-to-heat and ready-to-eat meals cited as growth drivers.
trends.context: Large grocers are using own-brand meal solutions to capture value-seeking shoppers, tightening competition for premium frozen and prepared meal occasions.
